title: The EDM inverse problem: Identifying the sources of CP violation and PQ breaking with electric dipole moments
summary: Many extensions of the Standard Model (SM) generically introduce new sources of CP violation, which can induce observable $P$-odd and $T$-odd permanent electric dipole moments (EDMs) of nuclei, atoms, and molecules. A future observation of nonvanishing EDMs would therefore provide a sensitive probe of physics beyond the SM, while also posing a nontrivial inverse problem: identifying their underlying ultraviolet origin.
